name: ai-film-studio
description: Pre-production studio for AI-made films in Google Flow / Gemini Omni: locked bible, structure plan, storyboard, screenplay, and copy-paste prompts for eight formats, in any language Flow speaks.

interface.shortDescription: Turn a rough idea into a shot-ready plan for Google Flow.
interface.longDescription: Pre-production for AI films, start to finish. Give it one line — a vibe, a half-scene, a photo — and it builds the story, the locked character bible, the structure, the storyboard, the screenplay, and copy-paste Flow prompts. Eight formats: vertical Reels, YouTube Shorts, landscape short films, long-form episodes, ads, music videos, trailers, documentaries. Works in any language Flow speaks: prompts stay English, dialogue is written in the project language so Omni speaks it natively.
defaultPrompt: Start a Malayalam Reel series about a boy who finds a phone that shows the future.
Storyboard episode 1 of my vertical drama and write the Flow prompts.
I have a vague idea for a 10-minute short film — build the story, characters, and shot list.
